'''August 2000 Sherwood tournament (12 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Warp Drive Cards and Comics, Sherwood, Arkansas on 12 August 2000. It is known from Jared Beavers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1109">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-12-sherwood-arkansas-8-12-00d1109/ sherwood-arkansas-8-12-00], DeckTech (Jared "Romas" Beavers, 12 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-12-sherwood-arkansas-8-12-00d1109/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Warp Drive Cards and Comics, Sherwood, Arkansas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
